description: T-040 statistical (John, 2026-10-16: spawn and wander counts over a fixed number of server ticks): a sysop's character, made strong with the developer commands, watches the Newhaven Arena (1:2150) for 300 passes of the spawn timer (25 minutes) and fights whatever is there, so the room stays short of its maximum. stats.py compares the monsters created there (`... into the room from nowhere`, the spawn pass: 89/99 of the eligible passes) and those walking in from a neighbouring room (the wander pass, over the monster cache since T-086), each as a Poisson rate, gated at p > 0.01. `differential.py run --as USER:PASSWORD`.

mask.why: direction names carry a random capital letter and a backspace
the prompt's numbers only, never its labels (as m4)
the experience after random fights (st, exp): the number and its column padding, not the label
hit points and the maximum the tweak sets (st): the numbers and their padding, not the label

steps.note: MBBSEmu admits one connection per user; the previous sheet's session can still be held for a moment after its logoff ("... is already logged in -- only 1 connection allowed per user", live run 38953732059)
wait for the original to let the previous session go
the name again at the Username prompt MBBSEmu shows after the refusal
the character's maximum hit points, restored at the end
a known start: TWEAK CLEAR empties the pack, the worn items and the keys and zeroes the money
the watcher is no sheet: strong enough to end each arena fight in a round or two, so the room stays eligible for the spawn pass (it generates only while the room is short of its maximum)
the cycle: the room, a fight with the first monster there, else a five-second wait. The watch ends after its fixed time (`m2.stop`: 300 passes of the 5-second spawn timer, seccreate)
the room: the first monster's last word

steps.until: \*Combat Engaged\*|You don't see|You do not see

steps.note: to the end of the fight
out of the fight room (its monsters), to 1:2140 as m4's casts
back to the character as created (Human Warrior, Strength and Health 50, the rest 40), so the next entry's checks find it as made
level 1, which the experience allows: a level above it is taken down at the next entry and the stats reset into the editor

on_abort.note: out of the fight room (its monsters), to 1:2140 as m4's casts
back to the character as created (Human Warrior, Strength and Health 50, the rest 40), so the next entry's checks find it as made
level 1, which the experience allows: a level above it is taken down at the next entry and the stats reset into the editor

on_abort_note: played before the logoff when the script stops early (a required step timed out): the character goes back to as created, so the next run's entry is not stopped by the stat reset
